_about: Every physical part of every mech: one entry each. A mech's mass, centre of mass and inertia are summed from its parts (MechMass in scripts/mech/mech_mass.gd), never typed in. "collider" is the part's own fitted shape (no whole-mech capsules; see the physics supplement); null means it sits inside another part. Actuators are parts too, one entry per joint: "game_motor" names the magic motor in tuning.json used in game mode, and "bench" holds the realistic figures test bench mode (lane B6) uses. "inherits" copies another entry and deep-merges this one over it; "abstract": true entries are templates only. Figures marked draft come from lane A1 and are for B1/B6 to replace with the model's real ones.

act_linear_heavy.source: draft (lane A1): in the range of industrial 150 kN roller-screw electric cylinders
